    return int(''.join(filter(str.isdigit, text)))

# Apply the function to extract numeric values
df['acts_num'] = df['acts'].apply(extract_number)

# Step2: Convert to numeric types

df['stages_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['stages_num'], errors='coerce')

# Step3: Compute mean and standard deviation
mean_acts = df['acts_num'].mean()

mean_stages = df['stages_num'].mean()

# Step4: Identify outliers (more than 2 standard deviations away from the mean)

outlier_stages = df[(df['stages_num'] < (mean_stages - 2 * std_stages)) | (df['stages_num'] > (mean_stages + 2 * std_stages))]

# Step5: Determine if any outlier exists
